finite_source_contract.data: Read the complete mapped4B pointer field little-endian. Struct requires explicit aligned struct_vma+field_offset==pointer_vma with nonoverflow uint32 arithmetic. No guessed struct size/stride/ownership.
finite_source_contract.code: Declared known nonzero register, LUI<ADDIU, aligned complete4B mapped words, no mixed data/struct coordinates. Exact upperword bits (0x3c00|reg) and lowerword bits (0x2400|reg<<5|reg). target=(((upper&ffff)<<16)+signextend16(lower)) mod2^32, including ffff8000 wrap. ORI/loads/stores/other registers unsupported, not heuristically reconstructed.
finite_source_contract.invalid: Keep observed raw words when readable, target unavailable on invalidopcode/register/geometry/mapping. Never emit meaningless reconstructed target with a warning as legacy did. No ID/landing fallback.
finite_source_contract.multiple: Each input ref_site retains ordinal+raw facts. Duplicate target values do not collapse source sites. Distinct targets reported explicitly; no canonical choice, no append-style global refusal just because target values diverge.
finite_source_contract.mapping: Use existing validated ELF LOAD mapper for entire4B site intervals. BSS/unmapped/split/overflow sites cannot provide an observed word. Reuse mapper again for target address point (1B); file_backed/BSS/unmapped target is separate from decoding status. A decoded word pointing outside ELF is still a valid observed-word fact.
finite_source_contract.scope_limits: First closed source domain is extracted ELF, not arbitrary flat-file/ISO/sentinel transport. Mapping a target point does not prove a whole text stream extent. No second VMA/file algorithm or sentinel-base guesses.
